response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development (14+ years) and demonstrates strong technical leadership in developer tools, build systems, and testing infrastructure (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial). However, his people management experience is limited to team leadership roles rather than formal mid-to-senior management, and his industry focus has been broad rather than specifically in mobile-platform ecosystems. His remote work history and lack of direct mobile platform experience may require further validation.
strengths: Strong technical leadership in developer tools and testing infrastructure
Extensive experience with system design and architectural contributions (e.g., Dlang, Node.js, CI/CD)
Proven ability to mentor teams and drive technical initiatives (e.g., Refactoring Dojos, Selenium course)
concerns: Limited formal people management experience at mid-to-senior levels (only team leadership in smaller organizations)
Lack of direct experience in mobile-platform ecosystems or large-scale developer tooling
Inconsistent tenure in roles (frequent job changes, some short-term positions)
